observations: Photo shows tall stacks of used (tokunbo) car tyres piled outside a storefront.
Shop signage partly visible but not clearly readable; a sign fragment reads '...REWARD FOR PASSION...' and a phone number is faintly visible but blurry.
No rims or wheels are visible anywhere in the photo despite the seller's claim of selling 'tyres and rim'.
No single tyre is isolated for close inspection; sidewalls, tread depth, size markings (e.g. 195/65R15) and brand names are not legible on any tyre in the stack.
Tyres appear used, with visible wear, dirt, and some painted number markings (likely grading/batch marks used by tyre resellers), consistent with imported used tyres sold in bulk.
Two people are visible on a balcony in the background, unrelated to the tyres.
